name: mecanica-auth-lambda-soat
description: Function Serverless de autenticacao por CPF - Castor Garage (Tech Challenge Fase 3)

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/handler.mjs --external:aws-sdk
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../function.zip handler.mjs
